component.name: Refrain
component.summary: Discord Rich Presence for Apple Music on Linux

description.p: Refrain shows what you are listening to on Apple Music as your Discord status — whether the audio is playing in your browser (music.apple.com) or streaming from your iPhone over Bluetooth.
Features:

ul.li: Reads playback metadata from MPRIS (Apple Music in any major Linux browser)
Reads playback metadata from BlueZ AVRCP (any AVRCP-capable Bluetooth source)
Forwards track info plus iTunes-resolved cover art to Discord
System-tray icon with Play / Pause / Next / Previous controls
Settings window for sources, privacy mode, autostart and Bluetooth device picker

description.p: Same-day patch over 0.4.0. Makes the Last.fm connection status honest: it no longer shows "Connected as (connected)" with no username, and no longer claims "Connected" when only a keyring session survived without a usable API key/secret (scrobbling was inert). It now requires the full usable credential set and otherwise prompts to re-enter the key + secret and reconnect.

Full uninstall in one command. "refrain --uninstall" (or Settings → Advanced → Uninstall Refrain…) deletes every file Refrain created — config, logs, cover cache, scrobble queue, autostart entry, menu entry — and purges the Last.fm credentials from the OS keyring, then prints the one-liner to remove the program itself for your install type.

Also fixes pipx self-update (it failed with "No module named pip" because a pipx app venv ships no pip — Refrain now upgrades via "pipx upgrade refrain") and refreshes the README tray documentation to match the v0.2.7 icon overhaul.

Last.fm scrobbling — opt-in, alongside the Discord status, never a replacement. Bring your own Last.fm API account; the shared secret and session token are stored in the OS keyring (KWallet / GNOME Keyring), encrypted at rest, never in plain text. Scrobbles are written to a crash-safe offline queue so an outage or a quit mid-song never loses them.

Also: an actively-playing source now beats a stale paused browser tab; album art swaps into the same notification once it finishes downloading; the config writer preserves comments and unknown keys; the Settings window was reshuffled (Last.fm on its own tab, per-source Discord IDs behind an opt-in toggle) so no tab needs a scrollbar; and a new PRIVACY.md documents every data flow. Folds in the accumulated reliability fixes tracked as v0.2.8.

Tray menu polish + Discord-RPC reliability. Every tray action now carries an icon (theme-matched on Plasma / GNOME / Breeze), the song-info rows render in normal text colour with proper icons instead of greyed-out indented rows, and middle-clicking the tray icon toggles play/pause. Discord handshake errors (e.g. "User logged out", "Invalid Client ID") are now caught explicitly instead of crash-logged as unexpected exceptions, with a longer back-off so Refrain doesn't retry tightly while you're signing back in. The Settings → Updates "Latest release notes" pane populates on every restart regardless of the 24-hour update-check cooldown.

Localization expansion. Refrain now ships full UI translations for 8 additional languages — Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Polish, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese — covering an additional ~3 billion native speakers worldwide on top of English and German. Also fixes the empty "Latest release notes" pane that pipx-installed v0.2.5 showed on the Updates tab when no auto-check had fetched the body yet.

Same-day patch over v0.2.4. AUR and Flatpak updates now spawn a terminal emulator running the package-manager command (yay -Syu / flatpak update) instead of just displaying the command in a popup for the user to retype. The user confirms any sudo prompt in the terminal, the package manager retains state. Falls back to the previous message-box hint when no terminal is on PATH.

Polish + reliability release on top of v0.2.3. Time-display consistency across tray, Plasma panel media-controls applet and Discord (all three now read the same iTunes-corrected duration). Snap and Flatpak Discord builds reachable out of the box via sandbox-aware IPC-socket bridging. Inline release notes in Settings → Updates. Discord activity card always carries the Refrain brand as small_image so the cover gets the visual focus. Config drops unknown TOML keys instead of nuking the whole file when a newer-version key is encountered. DiscordRPC dedupes identical consecutive payloads. Browser hints expanded with Floorp, Waterfox, Mullvad Browser, Tor Browser, ungoogled-chromium. New docs/bluetooth.md walkthrough and FAQ entries on browser MPRIS troubleshooting. +13 unit tests, total now 125, all green; ruff + bandit + pip-audit + Dependabot all clean.

Reliability + portability pass. Sandbox-aware Discord IPC discovery so Snap and Flatpak Discord builds are reachable out of the box, Qt style plugin path augmentation extended to Debian / Ubuntu / Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE layouts so pip / pipx installs render in the system theme on those distros (was Arch-only in 0.2.2), Bluetooth fast-fail so VMs without bluez don't stall the poll cycle for 25 s, and "No system tray" advice extended past the GNOME AppIndicator hint to cover MATE, XFCE, and tiling window managers. Plus a Cancel button on the update dialog, orphan-download self-heal, per-window icons (no more gnome-control-center gear icon on Wayland), an iTunes-catalog duration override that fixes Discord briefly flipping a 2:11 song's total to 0:14 mid-track, and a six-step distro test matrix in docs/test-matrix.md.

Two roadmap features pulled forward: per-source Discord client IDs (so Apple Music and Bluetooth can render under different Discord applications, with their own artwork in the user's profile), and MPRIS-server mode (Refrain publishes itself as org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.refrain so KDE Plasma's panel media-controls applet, KDE Connect, GNOME Shell, etc. drive the same Play / Pause / Next / Previous as the tray and render the same track Discord renders).

Settings UI overhaul: every tab now uses a consistent GroupBox + form-layout with left-aligned titles, fixed-width inputs that hold across Plasma Breeze and other Qt styles, and a compact 220 px field default (360 px for the Discord group whose values need more room). Notification cover-art flicker is gone — `notify-send -i` and `image-path` now carry the same image so KDE Plasma can't briefly render the brand badge. Discord RPC defers the first update for a new track until the cover URL is in cache so the brand fallback never flashes in the activity card. Apply now auto-restarts when the Discord client_id changes (same pattern as the language switch). Dead D-Bus watcher code removed (155 lines), atomic config writes, AppImage updater validates downloaded size, RPC reconnect backoff capped at 15 s instead of 60 s.

First minor-version release. Five new features plus a batch of polish: theme-aware tray icons that follow the system dark/light scheme; idle detection that drops the Discord status when an MPRIS source is dangling; D-Bus PropertiesChanged listeners so track changes register instantly instead of within a poll tick; a first-run welcome wizard with live Discord IPC + iTunes diagnostics; translation infrastructure with German shipped and stubs for FR / ES / IT / PT / NL / PL / JA / ZH_CN open for community PRs. Discord activity layout cleaned up so the three RPC lines show title, artist, and album one per line.

Three real bugs caught during the Flathub demo recording. Skip Next/Previous now works on Apple Music in Chromium — when KDE's plasma-browser-integration owns the rich metadata but reports CanGoNext=False, controls fall back onto the browser's own MPRIS player. Discord status now renders as "Listening to <song>" instead of "Playing Refrain" (was wrong activity_type). The tray-icon tooltip mirrors the live progress so users get a real timer (DBusMenu doesn't refresh the menu's text while open, so the menu's own progress line was visibly frozen mid-song).

Same-day follow-up to v0.1.3 fixing the two issues v0.1.3 shipped with: AppImage filename was rendered as "Refrain-.version.-x86_64.AppImage" because of a broken {version} placeholder, and the AppImage icon wasn't bundled because the icon_bundler walks XDG icon paths but the recipe used files.include. Both fixed. Plus AUR refrain and refrain-git are now live, and the Flatpak manifest is validated locally end-to-end against KDE 6.10 + the PySide BaseApp.

Start-on-Login now works for venv / pipx / pip --user installs (the autostart .desktop no longer assumes `refrain` is on $PATH at session-startup time). The noisy Qt XDG-portal warning is suppressed in the live log. PyPI publishing is wired into the release workflow via Trusted Publishers, so installs via `pip install refrain` now Just Work.

More production-readiness: empty Discord client_id no longer spams reconnect attempts, the cover-art toggle is now actually honored by the desktop notification, AppImage restart uses $APPIMAGE explicitly, the AppImage build recipe was fixed, and the tray menu shows a Discord connection indicator. Reset-to-defaults and Open-log-folder buttons added to Settings → Advanced.
Reliability fixes for desktop notifications, in-app Restart (tray + Settings), CodeQL false-positive suppressions, and minor dead-code cleanup.
Initial public release.
